faq_heading: Homes near West Langley Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the West Langley Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the West Langley Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names West Langley Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near West Langley Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 72 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,265,000, townhomes $820,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near West Langley Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of West Langley Elementary the median was 16 days on the market, closing at 98.2% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 72 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to West Langley Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are James Kennedy Elementary (0.9 km south), Topham Elementary (1.1 km south-east) and Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km south).

How the West Langley Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names West Langley Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of West Langley Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 72 homes sold within 1 km of West Langley Elementary: 47 houses and 25 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,265,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of West Langley Elementary

9 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of West Langley Elementary in a straight line (7 elementary, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 0 independent). The closest is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is Lynn Fripps Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: James Kennedy Elementary (0.9 km south), Topham Elementary (1.1 km south-east), Gordon Greenwood Elementary (1.3 km south-west), des Voyageurs (1.8 km south-east), Dorothy Peacock Elementary (1.9 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is James Kennedy Elementary, 0.9 km south of West Langley Elementary.
